node_fault_after_measurement.when: mid-lane on 2026-09-05, between the throughput cells and the quality/stability/lossless cells
node_fault_after_measurement.effect: every card raised a fault whose recovery action is an OS-level reboot; the driver could no longer initialise anywhere on the machine
node_fault_after_measurement.trigger: the accelerator kernel modules were reloaded while CUDA processes were still being torn down, racing the teardown
node_fault_after_measurement.misleading_signal: the management interface kept reporting every card healthy because the management library still answers while the compute driver cannot initialise
node_fault_after_measurement.rule: let every CUDA process exit fully, and confirm it, before touching the kernel modules; after a fault check driver initialisation directly, not the management summary
node_fault_after_measurement.scope: every receipt in this directory was measured on healthy cards, before or after the fault; the 873 s boot is the post-recovery one

humaneval.metric: pass@1 by executing the reference tests

structured_output.metric: strict JSON parse plus required top-level fields

inspected_failures.cause: gold 13, predicted 12 — arithmetic right, break-even year miscounted by one; finish reason stop, not a truncation

lossless.finding: greedy output is not reproducible on this stack, and speculation is not the cause: speculation off disagrees with itself on 14 of 20 prompts. Under pipeline parallelism the number of accepted draft tokens per step varies with batch composition, changing the shape of the verification forward pass and so the reduction order in the kernels
lossless.consequence: the on-versus-off row sits below both noise floors and cannot be read as a speculation effect; quoting it without the two control rows is quoting noise
